recommendation: Keep the commit as-is. It is a narrow core-template fix that completes the missing coverage found during reconciliation without changing generated artifacts or broadening the shared clipboard implementation.
issue_request: FHIR-20356 was Published/Persuasive for a non-substantive enhancement to add copy-to-clipboard buttons next to canonical URLs for conformance artifacts, with StructureDefinition and CodeSystem-style pages called out.
initial_application: No Jira-tagged source commit was found for FHIR-20356. The relevant prior implementation appears to be ab3a27bc56c3d212b592f187e9438b3e2a41339d, which added the shared clipboard CSS/JS and wired CodeSystem, ValueSet, and Extension templates, but left active profile and search parameter canonical URL displays as plain text.
additional_context: FHIR-I minutes corroborate the Jira acceptance and popup/icon direction. Jira comments later said IG support was done but core still needed support. Current fhir.ini keeps profile inputs active and lists SearchParameter as an active resource, and existing source CSS/JS already defines the copy-text/btn-copy behavior used by other core conformance-artifact templates.
reconciliation: Reused the established copy-text/btn-copy pattern in tools/templates/template-profile.html and tools/templates/template-search-parameter.html, wrapping the profile canonical URL and search parameter full URL in copyable code markup and including the existing clipboard scripts on those pages.
source_changes: tools/templates/template-profile.html: wrapped <%profileurl%> in the established copy-text/btn-copy markup and included clipboard.min.js plus clipboard-btn.js.
tools/templates/template-search-parameter.html: wrapped <%search-param-url%> in the established copy-text/btn-copy markup and included clipboard.min.js plus clipboard-btn.js.
